commits.message:
fix: signature website field, job_description cleanliness for Core-ready postings

Two more real production gaps found reviewing job-board relay traffic.

1. The signature's "website" field was capturing the job-board relay's
   own platform URL ("https://jobs.nvoids.com", appearing twice in the
   footer) as if it were the recruiter's company website -- it says
   nothing about who the recruiter actually works for.
   JOB_BOARD_RELAY_URL_RE (app/email_parsing/signature.py) excludes
   known relay domains from _extract_website, the same way TRACKING_URL_RE
   already excludes marketing-link domains. When no real website is left
   in the signature text, _sender_domain_website_fallback derives one
   from the sender's own email domain instead -- an honest fallback
   (it's literally the domain the email came from, not a guess about
   wording) that never fires for a freemail sender (FREEMAIL_DOMAINS,
   promoted from private to shared in app/email_parsing/
   signature_learning.py so both modules use the same list) or a relay
   domain.

2. job_description only got truncated at three specific marker strings
   ("keywords:", "view this job online", "unsubscribe") -- a footer that
   used different wording still left the sender's own signoff line
   ("--") and contact block sitting inside the description that would
   go straight to Core. _strip_job_description_footer now also cuts at
   the email's own signoff boundary (SIGNOFF_RE, already used by the
   multi-position splitter and the signature parser itself), for both
   the single- and multi-position parsing paths -- one boundary rule
   instead of a marker-string list that has to be extended per vendor.

New coverage: a relay-only URL yields no website at all for a freemail
sender; a real corporate sender with no stated website gets one derived
from their own domain; the fallback never fires for freemail; a footer
with no recognized marker string still gets fully excluded from
job_description, from the signoff onward, while the real content before
it is untouched. Full regression suite (18 checks) green against a
fresh schema and rebuilt image.
